newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia GDP forecast achievable - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia GDP forecast achievable - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government's forecast of 3.5 percent economic growth for the 1996/97 year to June 30 was achievable.
"We think that that's quite achievable," Costello told reporters when asked about the target.
He was commenting after official data released earlier on Wednesday showed GDP grew 0.5 percent in the December quarter for annual growth of 3.1 percent.
